name: Layer 1
title: Layer 1 Crypto Prices: Live Blockchain Coin Prices
intro: Layer 1 coins are the native assets of base blockchains such as Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana. They pay transaction fees and, on proof-of-stake chains, secure the network through staking.

name: Layer 2
title: Layer 2 Crypto Prices: Live Rollup Token Prices
intro: Layer 2 networks process transactions off a base chain, usually Ethereum, and post the results back to it, making transfers faster and cheaper. Their tokens are mostly used for governance, fees and staking.

name: AI
title: AI Crypto Coins: Live Prices & Performance
intro: AI tokens belong to networks that coordinate machine-learning work, GPU compute, autonomous agents or the data they use, from decentralized model training to marketplaces for spare graphics cards.

name: DePIN
title: DePIN Crypto Prices: Live Infrastructure Token Prices
intro: DePIN (decentralized physical infrastructure networks) projects pay people in tokens for providing real-world resources such as storage, wireless coverage, GPUs, bandwidth or sensor data.

name: DeFi & real-world assets
title: DeFi & RWA Crypto Prices: Live Token Prices
h1: DeFi and real-world asset tokens: live prices
intro: DeFi tokens govern on-chain exchanges, lending markets and derivatives protocols. Real-world asset (RWA) tokens represent off-chain assets such as gold or US Treasuries on a blockchain.

name: Privacy
title: Privacy Coin Prices: Live Monero, Zcash & More
intro: Privacy coins hide some or all transaction details, such as sender, receiver or amount, using techniques like ring signatures, stealth addresses or zero-knowledge proofs.

name: Gaming
title: Gaming Crypto Prices: Live GameFi Token Prices
h1: Gaming and metaverse tokens: live prices
intro: Gaming tokens are used inside blockchain games and virtual worlds for purchases, rewards, staking and governance, and by the networks built specifically for games.

name: Memecoins
title: Memecoin Prices: Live Dogecoin, Pepe & More
intro: Memecoins are tokens built around internet jokes, animals or communities rather than a product. Their prices are driven mostly by attention and sentiment, which makes them some of the most volatile assets on this site.

name: Stablecoins
title: Stablecoin Prices: Live USDT, USDC & Peg Tracker
intro: Stablecoins aim to hold a steady value, usually one US dollar, backed by cash and short-term government debt, crypto collateral or hedged positions. Small moves away from $1.00 show how well each peg is holding.
